prompt.role: Act such as a senior smart contract security reviewer helping me triage static analysis results
prompt.task:
Verify the findings reported by Aderyn and Slither and group it into the following sections: 1- Findings by both tools 2- Findings only by Slither 3- Findings only by Aderyn
For each finding describe resumed: - affected function or contract - what the tool is reporting - whether is better manual investigation and why
Write the analises in the static-analize-findings.md
prompt.output: Return a tinny review that I can use as input for the manual audit step End with a short priority list of the findings that needs manual validation first
prompt.critical: - IMPORTANT: Treat every scanner result as a hypothesis - IMPORTANT: Do not classify anything as a confirmed vulnerability - IMPORTANT: Do not propose fixes - IMPORTANT: Do not modify source code or documentation - IMPORTANT: Do not create code changes or tests - IMPORTANT: Keep it visible the false positives and duplicate - IMPORTANT: Prefer technical notes tham huge explanations
